blocks.text: LINAMON, Lanao del Norte – Christian and Muslim leaders called for sustained mutual understanding and unity for peace to drive continued prosperity in the south during Thursday’s kickoff of the annual weeklong Mindanao Week of Peace (MWOP) celebrations. This year’s theme is “Many Journeys, One Humanity: Building Peace.” In a video message, Bishop Jose Ramirez III of the Diocese of Iligan noted the different cultures and traditions of Mindanao’s tri-people (Christians, Muslim and Indigenous Peoples or Lumads).
